suggested_experiment_name: GigaBREAD-0 (Broadband Reflector Experiment for Axion Detection)
coupling_convention: Kinetic mixing parameter χ (dimensionless), canonical dark photon coupling
notes: First results from GigaBREAD (Broadband Reflector Experiment for Axion Detection) searching for dark photon dark matter in the 44–52 µeV (10.7–12.5 GHz) mass range. Paper reports upper bound χ ≲ 10^−12 at 90% CL. The limit is approximately flat across the mass range 44–52 µeV; encoded as a two-point horizontal line at the lower and upper mass boundaries. Local DM density ρ_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm³ is explicitly stated in Eq. (1) and used in the analysis. The experiment is sensitive to dark photon polarizations perpendicular to Earth's surface. Systematic uncertainties total 23% (Table I), with the largest from detection efficiency simulation (20%).
